symptomShortText: Gloss level rejected at customer goods receipt

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-9755, Shift A - booth parameters set per the released recipe
EQ-PAINT03-004 bell speed and flow logged within band all shift
DOC-12440 Rev E - flash-off time shortened from 90s to 60s in the 2026-06 cycle-time project
Paint lot PNT-5540 viscosity and solids within spec, cert PASS
Gloss meter GA-0844 gauge R&R measured 31% of tolerance at the last MSA study on 2026-07-28, above the 30% acceptance threshold; the study was filed but the meter stayed in service
Booth 23.1C / 62% RH, within the 20-25C and 55-70% RH window

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was gloss rejected at the customer?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Gloss measured 71 GU against an 82-90 GU window

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was gloss low despite correct film build and paint? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Flash-off time was reduced from 90s to 60s in the June cycle-time project, leaving solvent in the film at cure

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the change reach production without a gloss impact assessment?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The cycle-time project treated flash-off as a throughput parameter rather than a quality-critical one

actions.actionText: Hold all T18 stock and re-measure a sample on the laboratory gloss meter
Sort the 204 units at the customer against the drawing gloss requirement
Restore the flash-off time to 90s in DOC-12440 and re-qualify the booth

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Holding the stock quickly limited further shipments
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The line and the laboratory reported different gloss on the same panels and the disagreement was not resolved before assigning a cause

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: T18 panels measured on gloss meter GA-0844 at the Booth 3 inspection station
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: T18 panels from the same booth and same shift re-measured on GA-0851 at the lab, which read 84-87 GU
isIsNot.notes: The lab and the line disagree on the same panels
